summary: Vylor Inc., the seed-segment SpinCo of Corteva, filed an 8-K reporting that on September 30, 2026 the Fourth Circuit summarily reversed a District Court order and remanded; on remand the District Court denied California's motion to enjoin the separation. Corteva's board declared a pro rata dividend of Vylor common stock to Corteva holders of record September 24, 2026, and waived the Legal Restraints Condition. The Distribution is expected to complete before 9:30 a.m. New York time on October 1, 2026. Watch for any renewed state antitrust challenge and when-issued trading depth.
